calculation.description: Cross-asset 40-day momentum relative to the equal-weight benchmark, scaled by the asset's 40-day annualized downside residual volatility. The signal is lagged one completed trading day to prevent look-ahead bias.

metrics.icir_definition: daily IC mean / daily IC standard deviation; prior annualized figure 0.814544 is retained only in regime notes

validation.regime_notes: Revalidation through 2029-07-25 fails the binding daily ICIR gate: IC 0.017578 passes, but daily ICIR is approximately 0.0512 (<0.0840); 2029 YTD IC -0.194559 and daily ICIR approximately -0.652.
